days.mission_in: Listen for one bird as you walk.
days.entry: Mom and Dad walked to the temple at the end of the road. A koel was calling from the coconut tree near the temple pond. The coconut seller was there with his cart, and they had one coconut each.
days.mission_out: Notice one tree with flowers on it along your way.

days.mission_in: Notice one tree with flowers on it along your way.
days.entry: Mom and Dad were out today. Koyal was still on the coconut tree. Bhajan was going on in the temple. The coconut seller was not there today.
days.mission_out: Listen for one bird you can hear from the path.

days.mission_in: Listen for one bird you can hear from the path.
days.entry: Mom and Dad were out today. There were a lot of flowers floating in the temple pond today, offerings maybe. We did not go too close.

days.entry: Mom and Dad were out today. There was another bird with the cuckoo, a small one, making a very loud sound. We both were thinking about which one it was, but we did not understand.

days.entry: Mom and Dad walked slowly today. It was humid and sticky. We sat on the temple steps for a bit.
